reviews.text: I recommend it. Professional, takes good care of the animals, and has a good rapport with clients. Fair price and good facilities. Hygiene, everything is very clean.
I love Paraíso Pet Hotel! I always leave my dog ​​there and she loves it too!
I've been a customer for over 20 years, and always very satisfied.
Great place! Very welcoming with pets. My dogs have always loved staying at the hotel. I highly recommend it!

Wonderful hotel, where there is no shortage of affection, care, attention and lots of fun!
Professionalism is always present in the treatment of the furry friends!
Without a doubt, I recommend it as a safe and reliable place to receive any dog!

Best place in Rio de Janeiro to leave your furry friend. Our dog has stayed here many times. Always very well treated, he doesn't even look back when he knows he's going to the hotel. The best part is being able to receive videos during his stay and knowing that he's always doing well.

My dog, Balto, has stayed at the hotel several times! Whenever we need to, it's the only place we consider. Every time we've had a wonderful experience, Balto is very well taken care of. And we love receiving daily videos of him having fun.

Excellent outdoor accommodation
The dogs love it
Always very careful
From the first time my dogs stayed there, they loved it and have already gone back several times!
The best pet hotel in Rio de Janeiro!
Excellent hotel, Majuzinha always comes back super happy and the videos are great!

Very pleasant and reliable environment. Roberto is very careful and has a great attitude.

I recommend it!

Maju simply LOVES going to the hotel! 🥹🐶💜 She plays, runs, has so much fun, and we feel super relaxed because they are very attentive and caring with her. She always comes back smelling great and completely exhausted from playing so much …
I loved the experience at Paraíso Pet Hotel. Roberto and Ana were super attentive and made us feel very comfortable leaving our Moana with them. She also loved the environment surrounded by nature!
